issue: Swiss native geometry unavailable due to study adapter source-ID mismatch
scope: Study runner bridge; these findings do not evaluate the production native upload backend. IFC length/volume sources use a separate backend and are unaffected.
cause: Runner supplies page.source_id = Swiss dataset ID, but Registry deliberately derives source_id = page_id. The injected legacy NativeBackend retains Swiss dataset-ID keys; GeometryTools.native_room_candidates cannot find the page ID and returns unsupported_native_source before extraction.
interpretation: Computed-area results are raster fallback results, not evidence of failed native geometry extraction. Both routes share this limitation.
